rounds.text: Srinibas Pradhan Constructions Ltd demonstrates exceptional capital efficiency, with an ROE of 28.81% and an ROCE of 29.28% significantly outperforming sector benchmarks of 10.03% and 12.39% respectively [E9, E10]. This performance is supported by a robust multi-year growth trajectory, evidenced by a 51% compounded sales growth and 77% compounded profit growth over the last three years [E14, E16]. The company is currently trading at a valuation discount, with a P/E of 10.44x compared to the sector benchmark of 14.87x and an EV/EBITDA of 6.06x against the sector’s 8.63x [E6, E11]. Furthermore, the intrinsic value suggested by a discounted cash flow analysis sits at Rs 425, implying a substantial margin of safety of 53.0% relative to the current market price [E34, E35]. Conceded: the company faces challenges with negative operating cash flow of Rs -5.09 Cr and a cash conversion ratio of -0.62x in Mar 2026 [E24, E25]. Conceded: the company has high debtors of 155 days and an increase in working capital days from 45.9 to 88.5 [E41, E42]. Despite these liquidity headwinds, the firm has successfully reduced its borrowings from Rs 17.25 Cr to Rs 15.26 Cr, maintaining a moderate debt-to-equity ratio of 0.37x [E28, E30].
